Record notes

Seven pinned animation methods, public example metadata and complete revisioned local storyboarding.

Version 0.1.3 includes 1 complete skill procedures. Complete runtime, 30-family/38-example metadata catalog and seven MIT methods; external media and creative reference bundles excluded.

Requirements: Python 3.12 recommended; MCP and Pillow dependencies; MCP Apps supporting host for the widget.

License scope: AGPL-3.0-only AND CC-BY-SA-4.0; retained upstream licenses as scoped in LICENSE-SCOPE.json. Read the packaged notices and provenance before reuse.

Install with codex plugin add video-templates@working-tools after adding JonathanKHobson/working-tools-plugins, or the documented Claude Code marketplace path. Installation and tested compatibility.

This ZIP keeps its portable manifest at the root and preserves the referenced package files. This release includes a separate per-file hash inventory. Built from a12727e05886910a5830485bab497e7cadabd8c0. SHA-256: 92eb3c085d8bb444480a30998e42e7615eece49bf537c2d46fc5ad99132432ed.

Native marketplace distribution is separate from official OpenAI Plugin Directory publication. External provider access remains a prerequisite.
